# Trimble Maps Fleet Configuration API (CoPilot)

- **Product:** Trimble Maps Fleet Configuration API (CoPilot) (Trimble Maps family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** Bearer token from POST /accounts/authenticate. Declared security schemes: Bearer.
- **Access:** CoPilot fleet administrators.
- **To call it you would need:** Trimble Maps fleet-configuration credentials for fleets.trimblemaps.com.
- **Documented servers:** `https://fleets.trimblemaps.com/api/assets/v1/`, `https://fleets.az.trimblemaps.com/api/assets/v1/`.
- **Definition:** [trimble-maps/fleet](https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/api/fleet.json) (Fleet API, version 0.1.0). Documentation: https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/fleet-configuration/fleet-api, https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/fleet-configuration/fleet-api/.
